{{Quote|Now that you've piloted us out, I can get us to the closest system.|[[WAC-47]] to [[R2-D2]], flying to the Iego system after escaping a dangerous [[asteroid field]]|<ref name="D-Squad 1">[[Dark Droids: D-Squad 1|''Dark Droids: D-Squad'' 1]]</ref>}}
The '''Iego system''' was located in the [[Ash Worlds]] [[sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[planet]] [[Iego]] and its [[Moons of Iego|one thousand moons]]. Early in the [[Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the Separatists occupied Iego and installed a [[LaserWeb Defense Station|laser web]] in its [[moon]]s which left anyone on the planet unable to leave. The [[Laser web|web]] remained in place until the [[Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] arrived seeking the [[Reeksa|cure]] for the deadly [[Blue Shadow Virus]]. Upon deducing what was going on, they and the [[astromech droid]] [[R2-D2]] used repurposed [[Vulture-class starfighter|vulture droids]] to deactivate the deadly security system, ending the "curse" of Iego.

==Description==
The Iego system was situated in the [[Ash Worlds]] [[sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="Hoth" /> and [[The Slice|Slice]] regions,<ref name="The Slice" /> at [[Standard Galactic Grid|grid coordinates]] T-7.<ref name="TFABG" /> The [[Star system|system]] contained the [[planet]] [[Iego]], famed as the legendary "World of a Thousand [[Moon]]s" for its [[Moons of Iego|many moons]].<ref name="MoaTM" /> The [[Diathim]],<ref name="HC14">{{HelmetCollectionCite|14|Databank A-Z}}</ref> a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] known as the semi-mythical "Angels" of Iego, resided on the moon [[Millius Prime]].<ref name="MoaTM" />

==History==
The Iego system was primarily famous for the planet of Iego, whose one thousand moons were famous [[The galaxy|galaxy]]-wide on other far-flung Outer Rim worlds such as [[Tatooine]], along with the Angels which dwelled there.<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> In [[32 BBY]],<ref name="SWGA">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> the then-[[Slavery|slave]] [[Anakin Skywalker]], who grew up on Tatooine, asked [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] if she was an Angel and told her he had heard of them from [[spacer]]s when he first met her.<ref name="TPM" />

Early in the [[Clone Wars]], a [[galaxy]]-spanning conflict between the [[Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] which lasted from [[22 BBY]] to [[19 BBY]],<ref name="SWGA" /> the Separatists occupied Iego for a time, constructing<ref name="MoaTM" /> the [[LaserWeb Defense Station]]<ref name="MoaTM EG">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/mystery-of-a-thousand-moons-episode-guide|text="Mystery of a Thousand Moons" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}}</ref> in its moons. The [[laser web]]'s primary generator was constructed on Millius Prime, the Diathim forced off of their home in the process. Afterwards, the Separatists abandoned Iego, leaving the security system active. As a result, everyone who remained on Iego was trapped and unable to leave, as the laser web destroyed any [[starship]] which attempted to make it through. The Iegoans began attributing the situation to a curse laid by the mythical figure [[Drol]].<ref name="MoaTM" />

In [[21 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TCWcanondates|118}}</ref> [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and his former apprentice Skywalker, now a [[Jedi Knight]], [[Mission to Iego|traveled]] to Iego from<ref name="MoaTM" /> the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] planet<ref name="USW">''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]''</ref> [[Naboo]] seeking [[reeksa]] root, the only known cure for the [[Blue Shadow Virus]],<ref name="MoaTM" /> a disease [[Death|lethal]] to almost all lifeforms which had been resurrected by [[Doctor]] [[Nuvo Vindi]], a [[scientist]] working for the Separatists.<ref name="BSV">{{TCW|Blue Shadow Virus (episode)}}</ref> The virus had been unleashed in Vindi's [[Trade Federation laboratory|laboratory]],<ref name="MoaTM" /> a leftover from the [[Trade Federation]]'s [[Invasion of Naboo|invasion]] of Naboo,<ref name="BSV" /> while Republic personnel were conducting cleanup sweeps of the lab, and almost everyone trapped inside, including [[Senator]] Amidala and Skywalker's [[Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano]], had been infected.<ref name="MoaTM" />

Skywalker and Kenobi persuaded a resident of [[Cliffhold]] [[city]], [[Jaybo Hood]], to show them where to find the reeksa [[vine]]. However, after retrieving the root, the two [[Jedi]] were informed of the "curse of Drol" which prevented them from leaving. A flight offworld in their [[G9 Rigger-class light freighter|freighter]] ''[[Twilight]]'' led them to discover the laser web, and at a meeting with the citizenry, Kenobi and Skywalker informed the Iegoans of the true nature of the threat which kept them trapped. Hood had salvaged many abandoned [[battle droid]]s left behind by the Separatists, and gave Skywalker, Kenobi, and their [[astromech droid]] [[R2-D2]] control of several [[Vulture-class starfighter|vulture droid]] [[starfighter]]s. As Skywalker piloted the ''Twilight'' through the laser web, R2 piloted the vulture [[droid]]s into the generator on Millius Prime, destroying the security system, after which Kenobi informed the Iegoans that they were once again free to leave their planet whenever they chose. Kenobi and Skywalker returned to Naboo with the reeksa root in time to save Amidala, Tano, and the surviving [[clone trooper]]s inside Vindi's laboratory.<ref name="MoaTM" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Iego_system.jpg|thumb|right|275px|Iego system concept art by Jackson Sze.]]
The Iego system first [[canon]]ically appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] episode "[[Mystery of a Thousand Moons]],"<ref name="MoaTM" /> which premiered on [[Cartoon Network]] on [[February 13]], [[2009]].<ref name="MOATM Old EG">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode018.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Mystery of a Thousand Moons}}</ref> It was first canonically identified in the [[2022]] [[Star Wars Encyclopedia (series)|''Star Wars Encyclopedia'']] booklet "[[Hoth and Other Planets in the Outer Rim]]."<ref name="Hoth" />
